name: Wendy's Neverland: Geomeul Deun Sonyeoui Wangjanim
original_name: 웬디의 네버랜드 검을 든 소녀의 왕자님
source:
A little story of Wendy before she meets Peter Pan. Inspired by J. M. Barrie’s ‘Peter Pan’.

Wendy is approaching her seventeenth birthday. With her debutant on the way, her aunt introduces Wendy to a wealthy viscount who is eager to marry Wendy. A story of Wendy’s fight to stop the marriage and her struggles in becoming a proper lady!
